distribution.narrative: Lin & Smith (2022) directly records the species from Taiwan, Taichung City. No mainland China occurrence is inferred.

host_note: Lin & Smith (2022) reports Castanopsis cuspidata var. carlesii as a host; it is retained at the published infraspecific resolution.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Cyclorhipidion wui Lin & Smith, 2022.

taxonomic_history.name: Cyclorhipidion wui
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: Lin & Smith (2022) described Cyclorhipidion wui as a new species. The existing stable identity VSN_2064 is retained.
